name: haimunia-browser-check
description: On-demand real-Chromium smoke tests for service worker, fonts, offline behavior, and DOM interactions. playwright is pinned EXACTLY, not caret-ranged: the library version selects the Chromium build (1.62.1 -> revision 1234, Chromium 151.0.7922.34), and that build is what the measured layout numbers in CLAUDE.md come from. Moving it is a decision someone makes and re-measures, not something a range does quietly.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
